div.head: Af 2
div.ab: {III} Gif hwa þara mynsterhama hwelcne for hwelcere scylde gesece, þe cyninges feorme to belimpe, oððe oðerne frione hiered þe árwyrðe sie, age he þreora nihta fierst him to gebeorganne, buton he ðingian wille.

If someone for whatever offense should seek out some sanctuary that is supported by the king’s render or another free and honorable [religious] househould, let him have a three-night time period to protect himself [therein], unless he wishes to settle.

If a man flees, for any manner of offence, to any monastery which is entitled to receive the king's food-rent, or to any other free community which is endowed, for the space of three days he shall have right of asylum, unless he is willing to come to terms [with his enemy].

III. Gif hwa þæra mynsterhama hwylcne gesece for hwylcere scylde, þe cyninges feorme to belimpe, oþþe oðerne freonne hyred þe arwyrde sy, age he ðreora nihta fyrst him to gebeorganne, butan he þingian wille.
